adaptive_search_disclosure: This family was opened after broad purchase drift failed development gates in section 6.209. It is a new SEC reporting-owner semantic, but it is adaptive research rather than pristine discovery.
hypothesis: Open-market purchases by economically distinct insider roles may contain more stable information than pooling every reporting owner.

event_contract.transaction_source: Corrected official SEC Form 4 accession table from section 6.208
event_contract.role_source: REPORTINGOWNER.tsv in official quarterly SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets, joined by exact accession
event_contract.purchase: NONDERIV_TRANS code P plus acquired code A
event_contract.availability: First full PIT trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly after SEC acceptance
event_contract.role_attribution: An accession receives a role flag when at least one reporting owner has that relationship/title. SEC flattened transactions are not owner-keyed, so joint-owner filings cannot attribute a transaction to one owner; this limitation is reported and no owner is selected post hoc.
event_contract.ceo: Case-insensitive title contains chief executive or standalone CEO
event_contract.cfo: Case-insensitive title contains chief financial or standalone CFO
event_contract.nonofficer_director: Relationship contains Director and does not contain Officer
event_contract.role_dollars: Sum purchase dollars only from exact accessions carrying that frozen role flag

market_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 representative per SEC issuer CIK, current price>=5, lagged ADV20>=10m
market_contract.stage_boundary: Independent $100k development and validation books; only complete holds inside each stage

portfolio_contract.overlap: No new position while issuer CIK is active

selection_rule.ranking: Highest base Sharpe among candidates passing all development gates
selection_rule.tie_break: Higher stress8 Sharpe, then more entries, then variant name
selection_rule.selection_isolation: Select once on development; validation cannot substitute another role

audit_requirements: Report role coverage, joint-owner ambiguity, signal/entry counts, both costs, yearly PnL, dollar and percentage DD, concentration, turnover, exposure, and missing marks.
Report broad-PIT beta/residual attribution separately without changing selection.
No old-62 issuer selection, no refill shortcut, and no 2025-2026 rows.

pre_performance_repairs: The first replay attempt stopped during the accession-role merge before signal construction or performance measurement because accession_compact had mismatched CSV dtypes. Both merge keys were canonicalized to stripped strings; no candidate rule or threshold changed.

The second replay attempt stopped during executable-date filtering before signal construction or performance measurement because the assigned session column had object dtype. Assigned sessions were canonicalized to datetime64[ns]; no candidate rule or threshold changed.

The third replay reached simulation with an empty accession-role join because accession_compact leading zeros had already been lost during CSV inference; every printed PnL was therefore the invalid zero-book result and output writing failed on empty contributions. accession_compact is now read as string at ingestion. No valid signal or family performance was observed and no candidate rule or threshold changed.
